purpose: Review a finite Campaign130 catalog against all 151 complete logical definitions, the earlier terminal event registry and the accepted source schemas, without opening any Campaign130 source row or research value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: dividend_cash_and_bonus_joint_strength
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Cash per ten shares, bonus ratio, event count and freshness already have frozen capacity outcomes of 123, 49, 4 and 110 potential cohorts against the 200 minimum. Combining the sparse fields or changing the age rule would rescue the same terminal dividend-plan event family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: analyst_rating_breadth_or_report_count_confirmation
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Analyst rating-upgrade share already received its one frozen diagnostic and failed yearly stability, tail and drawdown gates. Report count, first coverage, static rating, text and alternative event ages were explicitly closed after that outcome.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: restricted_share_unlock_pressure_acceleration
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Restricted-share unlock pressure already passed capacity and completed a terminal return diagnostic. Adding an acceleration, event window, subtype or freshness transform after the result is an exposed supply-event operator retry.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: insider_and_major_holder_buy_consensus
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted insider and major-holder event snapshots
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Insider buy share and major-holder direction, ratio, amount and freshness are terminal ownership-event definitions. Their consensus is a post-exposure combination of failed event branches rather than a new point-in-time information state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: billboard_block_trade_order_flow_confirmation
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted daily billboard and block-trade snapshots
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Billboard net-flow states and block-trade premium, turnover, count and freshness were already included in the completed transaction-event branch. Cross-confirming them after the terminal outcomes is an exposed factor combination.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: minute_auction_imbalance_or_volume_at_price_proxy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The immutable minute source contains bars rather than order-book depth, queue, aggressor side or auction imbalance. Reconstructing those states from OHLCVA would be a semantic proxy downgrade and would also reuse terminal price, amount, range and transaction-price profiles.

selection.reason: Every finite proposal is capacity-terminal, return-terminal, a post-exposure combination, or requires an unobserved order-book state that accepted bars cannot lawfully proxy.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Begin only from a genuinely new prevalue mechanism or a separately accepted point-in-time source; preserve all Campaign129/130 rejections and the exact 151-definition/140-comparator orders.
